summary: Retest of the iteration_15 fixes. All fixes verified. (1) WhatsApp campaign: the NameError 'cfg' is gone. A campaign run against the unlinked instance completes with failed=1, and the reason is the clear STATE_HELP text ('WhatsApp is waiting for the QR scan...' because the state is 'connecting' after the QR call). (2) _evo_error and _state no longer crash on list/str/null/non-JSON/non-dict bodies: the v15 test test_list_json_error_body_does_not_crash passes, plus 13 new parametrized unit tests. (3) No regressions in the v15 and v16 WhatsApp suites (status, 409 sends, qrcode, sync, settings 404): 32/32 pass after updating the v16 DISC prefix to accept the reworded 'connecting' help text. (4) Frontend: the Settings Channels subtitle now reads 'WhatsApp connects through the server — link the phone in WhatsApp Inbox → Settings.' There is no 'mocked in v1' and no Twilio. The wa-not-configured banner source text mentions scanning the QR code. It is correctly hidden in the UI because configured=true. One new minor, pre-existing bug found in campaign counters.

minor.issue: When a recipient is skipped (WhatsApp lead with no phone / email lead with no email), `continue` jumps past the per-iteration db.message_campaigns.update_one. The skipped count is lost when the skipped lead(s) are last in the list. Reproduced: an email campaign to lead 'Race' (email=None) ends status=completed, total=1, sent=0, failed=0, skipped=0. Fix: persist the counters in a `finally` block, or include sent/failed/skipped/errors in the final 'completed' $set.

action_items: In _deliver_campaign, save sent/failed/skipped/errors in the final 'completed' update (or a finally block) so skipped recipients are counted
critical_code_review_comments: _deliver_campaign: the skipped counter is not persisted when `continue` is hit on the last lead(s)

WhatsApp campaign: each recipient still triggers its own connectionState pre-check plus a 1.5s sleep. Consider checking the state once up front and aborting the campaign with a clear message when it is not 'open'
